819771.ov: Kishan, a bandit, is betrayed by his friend, gets arrested and is sent to prison during the British rule in India. The police suspect his wife and brother, Jeona, of aiding Kishan so they torture them mercilessly. The wife is killed, but Jeona escapes, and becomes a bandit. Can he avenge his bhabhi`s death?

958907.ov: Patola is a 1988 Punjabi film, produced by J.P. Pardesi, Rammi Bhalwan and Manjit Lovely. It was directed by Jagjeet, with music by Mohammad Sadiq.

1374779.ov: A family shattered when their son leaves for studies. Years later, another son embarks on the same journey, revealing hidden truths and lies.

1499835.ov: Komal loves setting birds free, but never saw the invisible cage around her own dreams. When society tries to clip her wings, she begins to fight back. Pinjra is not just her story—it’s the story of every girl told to “stay in her place.” But today’s girls aren’t staying silent.

1649723.ov: A young man sacrifices his chance at love to preserve a cherished friendship. When loss reshapes their lives, he carries forward an unfulfilled dream of universal education, keeping alive the memory of the woman who inspired it.

1784507.ov: Basant Kaur dreams of representing India in kabaddi, but her life changes after she is sexually assaulted and later betrayed again. Pregnant and traumatized, she survives on the streets until her former classmate Fateh takes her home and cares for her and her newborn child.
